checks.detail: Web and native package authorities identify 5.1.0.
The authoritative roadmap covers every feature release through 6.0 and the teaching manual.
Standalone players do not mount or initialize editor-only UI and services.
Embedded native players use a bounded, hashed v2 footer and retain a corruption test.
Build artifact types are visible and localized in English, German and Chinese.
System-default audio routing is best effort while explicit unavailable devices still report a blocking failure.
The launcher Snake template is visible, audited, scripted, build-ready, and statically valid.
Snake demonstrates keyboard and gamepad action bindings.
New desktop projects default to one file while an explicit legacy sidecar choice is preserved and explained.
